articles.title: Steve Kerr jokes about Stephen Curry's age and compares him to Michael Jordan: "30? 29?"
articles.standfirst: The Golden State Warriors coach highlighted the point guard’s form at 38 years old and explained why watching him play reminds him of his time alongside Jordan with the Chicago Bulls.
articles.summary: The Golden State Warriors coach highlighted the point guard’s form at 38 years old and explained why watching him play reminds him of his time alongside Jordan with the Chicago Bulls.
articles.body:
Stephen Curry is 38 years old, but Steve Kerr prefers not to look at his ID when talking about his performance. The Golden State Warriors coach was asked how old he would guess the point guard to be if he did not know his age, and he replied with a laugh: "I don't know. 30? 29? He's something special".

The joke came amid the praise Kerr has devoted to his player these past few days. The coach not only highlighted his form, but also made a very special comparison: watching Curry compete at this age reminds him of what he experienced when he shared a locker room with Michael Jordan on the Chicago Bulls.

Kerr finds similarities between Curry and Michael Jordan

Kerr knows well what it means to play alongside a legend. He was part of the Chicago Bulls during Jordan's second stint with the team and now, after more than a decade at the helm of the Warriors, he finds similar traits in Curry. He is not referring only to talent, but to the ability to keep making a difference even though defenses prepare specific strategies to stop them.

"Honestly, it reminds me so much of what it was like playing with Michael Jordan back then," the coach explained. He also noted that, night after night, it is surprising what Curry can do, regardless of the methods his rivals use to stop him.

Curry's secret to staying among the best

In another interview, this time on the Tom Tolbert Show, Kerr went deeper into the reasons that explain the point guard's longevity. For the coach, his performance is not the result of chance. Behind his ability to keep competing at the highest level is a constant commitment to physical preparation and endurance .

"I think it is very unusual to see someone like that. Players who can sustain it for that long usually share the same qualities in terms of total commitment to their physical preparation and their endurance," Kerr commented. In that group he also mentioned John Stockton, Steve Nash, and LeBron James, players who managed to maintain a very high competitive level during the final part of their careers.

The coach also focused on Curry's passion for basketball. His competitiveness and his desire to put on a show remain aspects that, in his view, are reminiscent of Jordan.

At 38 years old, Curry is playing his eighteenth NBA season and remains one of Golden State’s main offensive references. His coach’s praise carries added value: Kerr closely experienced Jordan’s time in Chicago and now watches from the bench as the Warriors point guard continues to deliver top-level performances

articles.title: Philadelphia 76ers vs Chicago Bulls: Where to watch Sunday's game and what time is the first pitch
articles.standfirst: The Bulls, at the bottom of the East, host the unstoppable 76ers at the United Center
articles.summary: The Bulls, at the bottom of the East, host the unstoppable 76ers at the United Center
articles.body:
Few stories better encapsulate the current divide in the Eastern Conference than the one that will unfold this Sunday at the United Center . In one corner, the Chicago Bulls , languishing at the bottom of their conference; in the other, the Philadelphia 76ers, currently tied for first place in the entire NBA.

The clash promises to be a reality test for the home team and a golden opportunity for the visitors to further solidify their credentials as contenders.

When and where to watch 76ers vs Bulls?

The game between the Chicago Bulls and the Philadelphia 76ers will be played on Sunday, November 8, 2026, with tip-off at 3:30 p.m. (2:30 p.m. Central Time and 12:30 p.m. Pacific Time). The game will be held at the United Center in Chicago, which has a capacity of 20,917 fans.

You can watch this game streamed on NBA League Pass, as well as on various local channels in Philadelphia and Chicago.

NBA Standings overview: how Chicago and Philadelphia are approaching today's game

The difference in context couldn't be more stark. Philadelphia comes in sitting atop the Eastern Conference with an 8-2 record, sharing first place overall in the league with the Los Angeles Lakers. The Sixers also lead the Atlantic Division, half a game ahead of the Boston Celtics.

Chicago, on the other hand, is having a forgettable start to the season. The Bulls are second to last in the East with just 1 win and 7 losses, placing them third to last in the entire NBA.

They are currently fourth in the Central Division, five games behind the division-leading Detroit Pistons. The most worrying statistic for home fans is their defense: having allowed 1,037 points in eight games and with a -144 point differential, Chicago has the worst scoring gap in the East.

Sixers vs Chicago lineups: experience versus rebuild

Philadelphia boasts a roster that blends explosive youth with a veteran heavyweight. Shooting guard Tyrese Maxey anchors the backcourt, supported by Jaylen Brown on the perimeter and Joel Embiid's presence in the paint.

Joining this core is 41-year-old LeBron James, who brings leadership and ball-handling skills, along with shooters like Kentavious Caldwell-Pope and Anfernee Simons. Young prospect VJ Edgecombe, just 21, rounds out a rotation with both established talent and future potential.

On the other side, the Bulls are betting on a much more inexperienced project. Australian Josh Giddey directs the offense from point guard, with scoring support from Norman Powell and Buddy Hield from beyond the arc.

The front row features young names like Lithuanian Matas Buzelis and Frenchman Noa Essengue, both just 19 years old, while Nic Claxton and Zach Collins share minutes in the post. It's a rotation with promising potential, but the early start has taken its toll.

Fight for the lead and danger zone

For Philadelphia, every win carries double the weight in the tightly contested top of the league: with the Lakers, Celtics, Rockets, Thunder, and Spurs breathing down their necks, the Sixers can't afford to slip up against rivals they're expected to beat. Maintaining their lead in the East and the Atlantic Division requires winning precisely these kinds of games.

Chicago, meanwhile, is already eyeing the bottom of the standings. Only the Milwaukee Bucks are below them in the East, and in the overall standings they share last place with the Clippers, Bucks, Kings, and Jazz. Reversing this trend is urgent before the season slips away from them in November.

What is the prediction for the Philadelphia 76ers vs Chicago Bulls game?

The context is stark: Philadelphia arrives as co-leaders of the NBA, while Chicago is one of the worst teams in the league, with a devastating point differential. At home, the Bulls can rely on the energy of their fans and the scoring prowess of Powell and Hield to make the game competitive at times, but the visitors' experience, depth, and solidity make the difference.

Everything points to a 76ers victory, who must continue to add points to defend their lead in the East.

articles.title: LA Lakers vs Detroit Pistons: Where to watch Luka Doncic today and what time the game starts at Little Caesars Arena
articles.standfirst: Pistons and Lakers, showdown of leaders in Detroit: Cunningham hosts a Luka who just keeps winning
articles.summary: Pistons and Lakers, showdown of leaders in Detroit: Cunningham hosts a Luka who just keeps winning
articles.body:
The NBA schedule delivers one of those matchups that mean more than just a regular-season game. The Detroit Pistons , who have become the big surprise in the East, host the Lakers , who lead the West.

Two trains launched at full speed cross paths in the Motor City, and here we tell you all the details of the game.

Where to watch and what time do the Lakers vs. Pistons play?

The game between Detroit and Los Angeles will take place this Sunday, November 8, at 6:00 p.m. Eastern Time (5:00 p.m. Central Time and 3:00 p.m. Pacific Time) , at the Little Caesars Arena in Detroit will open its doors, a venue with a capacity of 20,491 fans.

Nationwide, the broadcast will be carried by NBA TV, with local coverage on Spectrum SportsNet, Bally Sports Detroit, and FanDuel Sports Network; while you can stream it on: Fubo, YouTube TV, DIRECTV, Sling TV, and with NBA League Pass.

Preview: Lakers vs. Pistons standings and recent results

The standings photo says it all. The Lakers rule the Western Conference and share first place in the entire NBA with a record of 8 wins and 2 losses (80% wins), identical to that of the Philadelphia 76ers.

The Pistons, meanwhile, lead the Central Division comfortably and sit in third place in the East, just one game behind the top spot held by the Sixers and the Boston Celtics.

What stands out most is the Angels' offensive firepower: the Lakers have scored 1,220 points, the highest total in the entire league, with a +77 point differential.

Detroit, by contrast, builds its success on solidity: it has allowed only 814 points in 8 games, the best defensive mark among the leading teams, for a +75 differential that speaks to a very balanced squad.

The Lakers come in hot. In their last eight games they have only lost once, a thrilling 129-136 against Portland. Since then they have put together a devastating run to close out: 103-87 against the Clippers, 131-125 against Toronto, a commanding 138-117 over Miami and, in their most recent visit, 116-103 in Sacramento. This is a team that scores in bunches and has also learned to win through control.

The Pistons are not far behind, although their path has been bumpier. They opened the season by knocking off the Celtics and strung together some significant wins, including a 106-93 victory in Philadelphia. Their most recent steamrolling was a crushing 124-91 over Charlotte, but they are coming off a 106-112 home loss to the 76ers. They will want to wash away that defeat in front of their fans and against a high-profile opponent.

The stellar duel: Cunningham vs. Dončić

The biggest attraction is at point guard. 25-year-old Cade Cunningham, wearing number 2, is the engine of these Pistons : the American carries on his shoulders the playmaking duties of a team that has made defense its calling card.

Around him, Detroit has young pieces with enormous potential such as center Jalen Duren and versatile forward Ausar Thompson, as well as reliable shooters like Duncan Robinson and Kevin Huerter.

On the other side appears Luka Dončić, the 27-year-old Slovenian wearing number 77, a true beacon of an offense that overwhelms whoever stands in its way. He is joined by a luxury backcourt featuring Austin Reaves and Collin Sexton, while the paint is left under the responsibility of Walker Kessler and the veteran Kevon Looney.

The tactical question is served up: the Lakers' top-tier offense against the best defense among the Eastern contenders.

What's at stake at the top of the NBA standings

For the Lakers, every victory is pure gold in a brutally tight Western Conference: Houston, Oklahoma City and San Antonio are all sitting at 7-2 and breathing down their necks. Losing their footing in Detroit could cost them first place in the West and in the league.

For the Pistons, beating the NBA leaders would be a statement of intent. T hey are just one game away from the top of the East, and a win of this magnitude would place them firmly in the conversation among the conference’s top contenders, ahead of Cleveland (14th overall) in their own division and closing in on the Celtics and Sixers.

Lakers vs Pistons Prediction: Which team is favored to win?

The league’s best offense and one of its most reliable defenses collide. The Lakers arrive in overwhelming form and with greater scoring depth, but Detroit is playing at home, defends like few others, and has wounded pride after the loss to Philadelphia.

I expect a back-and-forth game, the kind that gets decided in the final quarter. Dončić's firepower tips the scales slightly toward the Angelenos, although it wouldn't surprise me at all if the atmosphere at Little Caesars Arena pushes the Pistons to pull off the upset. Slight favorites: the Lakers, but with home-court advantage as the great equalizer.

articles.title: Shaquille O'Neal trolls Angel Reese with her own celebration and leaves her visibly annoyed
articles.summary: Shaquille O'Neal playfully mocked Angel Reese during a reunion at LSU's college football game against Alabama on Saturday, November 7, 2026, in Baton Rouge, Louisiana.
articles.body:
Shaquille O'Neal playfully mocked Angel Reese during a reunion at LSU's college football game against Alabama on Saturday, November 7, 2026, in Baton Rouge, Louisiana.

The two basketball stars, both former LSU athletes, were among several prominent guests attending the game alongside actor Kevin Costner, former gymnast Livvy Dunne and baseball pitcher Paul Skenes.

While Reese was filming O'Neal on the sidelines, the NBA legend made her signature "too small" hand gesture, a celebration that had recently become a sensitive topic following the Atlanta Dream's WNBA Finals defeat.

Reese had used the gesture to taunt Golden State Valkyries players, particularly center Aminata Gueye, during Atlanta's 97-71 victory in Game 3, which gave the Dream a 2-1 series lead.

However, Golden State recovered to win the championship in seven games. During the Valkyries' victory parade, former NBA player Festus Ezeli also mocked Reese by displaying a shirt featuring her celebration combined with a crying Michael Jordan meme.

When Shaq repeated the gesture, Reese appeared irritated and swatted toward him, while O'Neal laughed and walked away.

Despite the reaction, the two have a longstanding friendship and mentor relationship. O'Neal has supported Reese since her LSU days and helped bring her into the Reebok brand.

The encounter was widely interpreted as friendly teasing rather than a serious dispute. LSU ultimately lost the football game to Alabama 31-13.

articles.title: video: Austin Reaves' frustration boils over as Lakers star repeatedly hits himself with a water bottle
articles.summary: Austin Reaves was caught in a tense moment during a Lakers game when he repeatedly hit himself in the head with a water bottle out of frustration. While fans saw the reaction as a reflection of how much he cares about winning, the unusual display also caught people off guard as his emotions got the better of him.
articles.body:
Austin Reaves was caught in a tense moment during a Lakers game when he repeatedly hit himself in the head with a water bottle out of frustration. While fans saw the reaction as a reflection of how much he cares about winning, the unusual display also caught people off guard as his emotions got the better of him.

Since LeBron James is gone, Luka Doncic and Reaves have had to shoulder the responsibility for keeping the Lakers competitive. The team has gotten off to an impressive 8-2 start, with much of the credit going to Doncic, but Reaves' contributions cannot be understated.

It takes a special kind of player to recognize when a teammate has the hot hand and willingly take a step back. Reaves has done exactly that through the first 10 games, finding ways to make an impact across the board. Still, moments like this reveal just how much he wants to win and how frustrated he can become when things don't go his way. Both stars are determined to keep the Lakers strong and prove they have what it takes to lead the team.

articles.title: Stephen Curry takes Riley and Canon to 49ers game for a family Sunday
articles.standfirst: The Warriors star took advantage of the NBA break to attend the matchup against the Raiders, where he also crossed paths with rapper E-40.
articles.summary: The Warriors star took advantage of the NBA break to attend the matchup against the Raiders, where he also crossed paths with rapper E-40.
articles.body:
Levi’s Stadium welcomed a very special guest this Sunday, November 8. Stephen Curry arrived with his children, Riley and Canon, to cheer on the San Francisco 49ers against the Las Vegas Raiders, taking a break from basketball to enjoy an afternoon of football . The game also gave him a chance to spend time with E-40, one of the Bay Area’s most recognizable music stars.

Wearing a white T-shirt and cap, along with sunglasses, Curry enjoyed the game from a suite alongside his little ones.

49ers dominate Raiders with a convincing win

San Francisco also had plenty to celebrate on the field. The 49ers defeated Las Vegas 38-17 in Week 9 of the NFL season after building a 21-10 lead before halftime.

Christian McCaffrey opened the scoring with a rushing touchdown before adding another after catching a pass from Brock Purdy . The quarterback also scored on the ground. In the second half, an interception returned for a touchdown extended San Francisco’s lead and made things even more difficult for the Raiders.

Las Vegas tried to fight back with a touchdown from Brock Bowers but lost two fumbles at crucial moments. Purdy later connected with Jordan Watkins for a 37-yard touchdown pass, while Eddy Piñeiro added the final points with a field goal.

The 49ers' victory put a sporting finish on an afternoon Curry got to enjoy with his children. His next stop will be back in the NBA, as the Warriors host the Pelicans this Monday .

articles.title: Bronny James argues with a Detroit fan who was ejected during the Lakers' victory: "How much money are you making?"
articles.standfirst: The Lakers guard became involved in a heated courtside exchange during a 121-116 win over the Pistons, despite not seeing any playing time
articles.summary: The Lakers guard became involved in a heated courtside exchange during a 121-116 win over the Pistons, despite not seeing any playing time
articles.body:
B ronny James had a difficult night on the court in Detroit, but that did not stop him from becoming one of the talking points after the Los Angeles Lakers secured a 121-116 victory over the Pistons on Sunday.

The 22-year-old guard was involved in a heated confrontation with a courtside spectator, with footage circulating on social media showing him exchanging words with the fan.

The incident reportedly ended with the spectator being ejected, while Lakers personnel stepped in to prevent the situation from escalating further.

Although the available video captures Bronny's response, it does not reveal what the spectator said to provoke him. Toward the end of the exchange, the Lakers youngster could be heard challenging the fan.

"Can you run a mile? How much money do you make a year?" Bronny was heard saying.

The comments quickly attracted attention, particularly given the scrutiny Bronny has faced since entering the NBA.

However, without footage of the beginning of the argument, it remains unclear what triggered the confrontation or whether the exchange involved any comments about his basketball career or famous family.

The incident also unfolded on a night when Bronny did not feature in the game. He had returned to the Lakers after a one-game assignment with their G League affiliate, the Coachella Valley Lakers, where he produced an encouraging performance of 22 points and seven assists.

His impressive outing in the developmental league offered a reminder of his potential, but he was unable to translate that opportunity into minutes against Detroit .

Bronny James continues to face pressure as he tries to establish himself in the NBA

The attention surrounding Bronny is hardly new. Since the Lakers selected him with the 55th overall pick in the second round of the 2024 NBA Draft, he has regularly been subjected to criticism from fans who believe his connection to LeBron James helped him secure his place in the league.

That argument has followed him throughout his early professional career, often overshadowing the challenges involved in developing as a young player at the highest level.

His NBA opportunities have remained limited this season. Through five appearances in the 2026-27 campaign, he has recorded four points in a total of 12 minutes, according to NBA statistics. Those numbers reflect how difficult it has been for him to earn a consistent role in the Lakers rotation.

There is a clear difference between his production in the G League and what he has managed in the NBA. His latest 22-point, seven-assist performance demonstrated that he can make an impact when given extended playing time, although establishing himself as a regular NBA contributor remains a separate challenge.

The Lakers ' competitive ambitions also make the situation more complicated. Rather than rebuilding around younger players, the franchise is focused on winning, meaning opportunities for development can be difficult to find when established players are available.

Sunday's game provided another example. Los Angeles was without Luka Doncic , who missed the contest because of lower-back tightness, but still managed to overcome Detroit thanks largely to Austin Reaves ' outstanding 43-point performance. The Lakers improved to 9-2 with their fifth consecutive victory.

For Bronny , however, the night will be remembered for something that happened away from the court.

The youngster has previously had to deal with criticism linked to his surname and his place in the Lakers organization. This latest exchange shows how that attention can spill into interactions with spectators, even when he is not participating in the game.

Until the full footage of the confrontation becomes available, the fan's contribution to the argument remains unknown.

What is clear is that Bronny was visibly frustrated, and the intervention of Lakers personnel helped prevent the situation from developing into something more serious.

articles.title: Acuff Jr., the rookie who is measuring up to Oscar Robertson and LeBron James
articles.standfirst: The Sacramento Kings player recorded 32 points and 10 assists against the Heat
articles.summary: The Sacramento Kings player recorded 32 points and 10 assists against the Heat
articles.body:
Darius Acuff Jr., the number 7 pick in the latest NBA Draft, was not among the top candidates to be Rookie of the Year . After 10 games, the Sacramento Kings rookie has completely changed the landscape. His numbers place him at the top of any "power ranking" of first-year players, being on the level of, or even surpassing, players like Cameron Boozer, Yaxel Landeborg, or Darryn Peterson.

One tremendous fact: only Shai Gilgeous-Alexander takes more shots than him. The Thunder player has taken 232 shots in 10 games ; Acuff 230 . And Tyrese Maxey is behind, with 210 in 11 games, the same as Victor Wembanyama, 206, also in 10.

This is nothing new; the latest from Darius Acuff Jr. is drawing level with two NBA legends, Oscar Robertson and LeBron James . He did it after his latest showcase with the Kings against the Miami Heat in the 108-114 loss. Acuff posted 32 points, 10 assists, and 5 rebounds in 39 minutes of play.

With that game, the Sacramento rookie joins Oscar Roberton (who did it in 1960-61) as the only rookies in history to record at least 250 points and 70 assists in their first 10 NBA games . Acuff has totaled 259 points and 74 assists.

In addition, with his performance against the Heat , the Kings player joins LeBron James as the only teenagers in NBA history to have multiple games with at least 30 points and 10 assists. James did it on three occasions, and Acuff Jr. already has two: his 34+14 against the Pelicans and the 32+10 against Miami. It should be remembered that Acuff Jr. is only 19 years old and will turn 20 on November 16. By that day, the Kings will have played two more games ( Orlando and Portland ).

articles.title: Jaylen Brown confirms zero relationship with Jayson Tatum before confrontation: “Nothing to talk about”
articles.standfirst: The Philadelphia 76ers star has no plans to reconnect with his former Celtics teammate
articles.summary: The Philadelphia 76ers star has no plans to reconnect with his former Celtics teammate
articles.body:
Jaylen Brown isn't interested in having a reunion with Jayson Tatum before the Philadelphia 76ers face the Boston Celtics .

After spending nine seasons together in Boston, the two former championship-winning teammates are preparing to meet as opponents, but Brown has made it clear that he doesn't intend to break the ice before tipoff.

Following Philadelphia's 127-121 victory over the Chicago Bulls on Sunday, Brown faced questions about his relationship with Tatum and whether they had spoken since his departure from Boston.

His initial response was straightforward: “Nope.” When asked whether he intended to approach Tatum before Tuesday's matchup, Brown offered an equally blunt explanation.

“Nothing to talk about. He’s on his side; I’m on my side. We’re both trying to win. So it’s nothing to talk about,” Brown said.

The Philadelphia forward was also asked about the relationships he had maintained in Boston and whether there were people he was particularly looking forward to seeing. He added: “I love Boston. Boston’s a great city. A lot of people I developed a relationship with, I am just focusing on what’s in front of me right now, and that’s the most important thing.”

His comments suggest that Brown wants to keep his attention on his new surroundings rather than revisit the circumstances that ended his time with the Celtics .

That doesn't necessarily mean every personal connection from his Boston years has disappeared, but his relationship with Tatum remains a particularly sensitive subject.

Trade that turned former teammates into rivals

Brown and Tatum were among the NBA's most successful partnerships during their time together. They helped Boston reach five Eastern Conference finals, appeared in two NBA Finals and ultimately won the 2024 championship against the Dallas Mavericks .

Their partnership lasted nine seasons, but the Celtics eventually decided to move Brown in a blockbuster offseason trade in July 2026. He joined Philadelphia in a deal that sent Paul George to Boston alongside draft compensation.

The separation quickly became a talking point after Tatum discussed the trade on his YouTube channel, explaining that he had been caught off guard by the decision.

Brown responded with a blue baseball cap emoji on Instagram, widely interpreted as suggesting that Tatum was not telling the truth.

Tatum subsequently played down suggestions of a serious feud, expressing frustration that the conversation had become focused on personal drama rather than what the pair achieved together.

Brown later offered a memorable response when asked about the possibility of tension between them: “There’s no beef, but it might be a little lamb chops and some gravy. He should stay ready at all times.”

He also made a pointed reference to Tatum 's public messaging, saying the Celtics star had a great PR team.

More than just personal history at stake

Tuesday's meeting is the first regular-season encounter between the former teammates since Brown 's move. Philadelphia enters the contest after improving to 9-2 with its win over Chicago, while Boston is also among the Eastern Conference's leading teams at 8-2.

Brown contributed 29 points against the Bulls , demonstrating the offensive production Philadelphia hoped to acquire when it completed the trade. He has quickly become an important part of a team with ambitions of challenging for the championship.

Tatum , meanwhile, remains central to Boston's plans. His familiarity with Brown 's game could make the individual matchup particularly interesting, while Brown knows the tendencies of a player he spent almost a decade practicing and competing alongside.

The attention surrounding their first competitive meeting will inevitably extend beyond the scoreboard. However, Brown has already made his position clear: he is not planning a conversation before the game.

Whatever remains unresolved between the two players will have to wait until after the basketball is finished.

articles.title: End of the GOAT debate? 30 unbelievable NBA records that prove LeBron’s dominance
articles.standfirst: From scoring milestones to unprecedented longevity, James' remarkable achievements have strengthened the argument for ranking him above Jordan
articles.summary: From scoring milestones to unprecedented longevity, James' remarkable achievements have strengthened the argument for ranking him above Jordan
articles.body:
The debate over basketball's greatest player has followed LeBron James throughout his career, but the Philadelphia 76ers superstar is building a statistical legacy that becomes increasingly difficult to challenge with every passing season.

Now in his record-breaking 24th NBA campaign, James has accumulated an extraordinary collection of achievements spanning scoring, playmaking, postseason success and longevity, extending his influence well beyond the achievements of most former superstars.

The four-time NBA champion is already the league's all-time leading scorer, while also holding records for career field goals, minutes played, games played and All-NBA selections.

His accomplishments have renewed comparisons with Michael Jordan , whose six championships and perfect NBA Finals record remain central arguments for those who consider the Chicago Bulls legend the greatest player ever.

Former Washington Wizards star Gilbert Arenas , however, believes James deserves the distinction because of his sustained excellence across different teams, generations and playing styles.

Speaking on the Get To The Point podcast, Arenas explained how watching James fulfill enormous expectations throughout his career changed his perspective on the debate.

LeBron James' remarkable records

James ' statistical achievements extend far beyond becoming the first player to score 40,000 regular-season points, a milestone he reached after surpassing Kareem Abdul-Jabbar's scoring record in 2023.

He is also the only player to combine at least 40,000 points with 10,000 rebounds and 10,000 assists, demonstrating an unusual balance between scoring and creating opportunities for teammates.

His 21 All-NBA selections, including 13 First Team appearances, represent league records, while his 22 All-Star selections underline his remarkable consistency.

James also leads the NBA in career playoff points, having scored 8,521, comfortably ahead of Jordan 's 5,987.

The forward's achievements include 188 postseason victories, a record 1,297 consecutive regular-season games scoring at least 10 points, and Finals MVP awards with three different franchises.

That versatility particularly impressed Arenas , who recalled how James had originally been described as combining Jordan 's scoring ability with Magic Johnson 's exceptional court vision.

"You said he was Magic Johnson with Michael Jordan ability. What I watched was Magic Johnson with Michael Jordan ability," Arenas said.

All 30 Lebron James NBA records

- NBA all-time leading scorer – Surpassed Kareem Abdul-Jabbar in February 2023 and became the first player to score 40,000 regular-season points.

- Most field goals made in NBA history – Surpassed Abdul-Jabbar's record of 15,837 career field goals and became the first player to make 16,000.

- First player in the 40,000-10,000-10,000 club – The only player to record at least 40,000 points, 10,000 rebounds and 10,000 assists.

- Most career playoff points – Has scored 8,521 postseason points, comfortably ahead of Michael Jordan's 5,987.

- Most All-NBA selections – Has earned 21 All-NBA Team selections during his career.

- Most All-NBA First Team selections – Holds the record with 13 selections.

- Youngest player to make the All-NBA First Team – Earned his first selection following the 2005-06 season at age 21.

- Most NBA All-Star selections – Has been selected for the All-Star Game 22 times.

- Most career NBA All-Star Game points – Has scored 449 points in All-Star appearances.

- Youngest NBA All-Star Game MVP – Won the award in 2006 at 21 years and 51 days old.

- Most regular-season games played – Has surpassed 1,600 career appearances, breaking the previous longevity benchmark.

- Most NBA seasons played – Entered his 24th season in 2026-27, extending the league record.

- Most regular-season minutes played – Has accumulated more than 61,000 minutes during his career.

- Most consecutive games scoring at least 10 points – Extended his remarkable streak to 1,297 regular-season games.

- Most career NBA playoff victories – Has recorded 188 postseason wins.

- Youngest player to reach 5,000 points – Achieved the milestone at 21 years and 22 days old.

- Youngest player to reach 20,000 points – Reached the milestone at 28 years and 17 days old.

- Youngest player to reach 25,000 points – Achieved the milestone at 30 years and 308 days old.

- Youngest NBA Rookie of the Year winner – Won the award in 2004 at 19 years and 123 days old.

- Oldest player to record a triple-double – Registered 28 points, 12 rebounds and 10 assists against the Dallas Mavericks at 41 years old.

- Oldest player to average at least 20 points, five rebounds and five assists – Maintained those averages during his 2025-26 campaign.

- Most regular-season games scoring at least 30 points – Surpassed Michael Jordan's record during the 2024-25 season.

- Most different franchises with NBA Finals MVP awards – Won Finals MVP with the Miami Heat, Cleveland Cavaliers and Los Angeles Lakers.

- First father-son teammates in NBA history – Made history alongside Bronny James with the Lakers in October 2024.

- Most career turnovers in NBA history – Has accumulated more than 5,600 turnovers.

- Most missed field goals in NBA history – Surpassed Kobe Bryant's career total.

- First player to lead a team back from a 3-1 NBA Finals deficit – Helped Cleveland defeat the 73-win Golden State Warriors in 2016.

- Cleveland Cavaliers' all-time leading scorer – Scored 23,119 regular-season points for the franchise.

- Most NBA Player of the Month awards – Has received 41 awards.

- Most NBA Player of the Week awards – Has collected 70 awards during his career.

Why LeBron James deserves the GOAT title

Arenas believes James ' consistency makes his career particularly difficult to criticize, even when compared with Jordan 's championship achievements.

"There's nobody who can say in the 24 years that they went into the season and he failed expectations that season," Arenas continued. "Not one time, not one season you can say was bad. That's GOAT sh*t."

James ' move to Philadelphia has provided another opportunity to extend his legacy, with the 41-year-old pursuing a fifth NBA championship alongside Joel Embiid, Tyrese Maxey and Jaylen Brown .

Winning another title would make James the first player to capture NBA championships with four different franchises, adding another unprecedented achievement to an already historic career.

Whether those accomplishments are enough to surpass Jordan remains subjective, but James ' extraordinary collection of records has ensured that the argument is far from settled.

articles.title: LeBron James breaks silence after alleged stalker enters his Los Angeles property claiming to be his son
articles.summary: LeBron James addressed a disturbing security incident at his Los Angeles property after a man was arrested on suspicion of felony stalking on Friday, November 6, 2026.
articles.body:
LeBron James addressed a disturbing security incident at his Los Angeles property after a man was arrested on suspicion of felony stalking on Friday, November 6, 2026.

The NBA superstar spoke to reporters on Sunday, November 8, following the Philadelphia 76ers' 127-121 victory over the Chicago Bulls. He emphasized that his family was safe and that they were still gathering information about the incident.

According to the Los Angeles Police Department, officers received a report of a possible burglary suspect at a property in the upscale Brentwood neighborhood at approximately 9:40 p.m. Friday.

Private security personnel had reportedly spotted an unfamiliar man on surveillance cameras and contacted authorities.

Officers arrived and found the suspect on the property. He was taken into custody without incident on suspicion of felony stalking.

Police confirmed that the man was unarmed and did not gain entry into the house itself.

Authorities have not publicly identified the suspect or explained how he accessed the grounds.

According to NBC Los Angeles, the man told responding officers that he was LeBron James' son.

There is no evidence supporting that claim, and investigators have not publicly explained why the suspect made it.

The man's identity and age have not been released.

Authorities also have not confirmed whether he previously attempted to contact James or had been involved in earlier security incidents at the property.

articles.title: Victor Wembanyama’s scary shooting stat makes his dominance even more impressive
articles.standfirst: The giant can dominate opponents through his size, finishing ability, rebounding and shot-blocking
articles.summary: The giant can dominate opponents through his size, finishing ability, rebounding and shot-blocking
articles.body:
Victor Wembanyama is already one of the most difficult players in the NBA to defend, but what makes his recent performances particularly frightening is that he may be doing it without having fully figured out his jump shot.

The San Antonio Spurs superstar delivered a spectacular performance against the Dallas Mavericks on Wednesday, recording 52 points, 24 rebounds and eight blocks. Those numbers would be remarkable for virtually any player, but Wembanyama managed to produce them despite struggling badly with his shooting from the perimeter.

In fact, the French big man was coming off a stretch in which his shooting percentages exposed an unexpected weakness in his offensive game. Following his 52-point explosion against Dallas, Wembanyama was shooting just 7-for-29 (24%) from mid-range and 12-for-50 (24%) from beyond the three-point line.

Those are hardly the numbers expected from a player with his combination of size, coordination and offensive versatility. Yet there was another detail that made his performance even more impressive: Wembanyama didn’t need his jump shot to dominate.

Of his 52 points against the Mavericks, 45 came either inside the restricted area or at the free-throw line. He converted 13 of 16 attempts in the restricted area and made 19 of his 23 free throws. In other words, even when his outside shooting wasn’t cooperating, Wembanyama found other ways to overwhelm the opposition. And that should be a frightening prospect for the rest of the NBA.

Wembanyama may have found his shooting touch

The encouraging development for San Antonio is that Wembanyama appears to have made progress with his perimeter shooting over the weekend. During the Spurs’ road games against Sacramento and Portland, the 7-foot-4 center wasn’t quite as dominant around the basket, but his three-point shooting improved considerably.

He connected on seven of his 12 attempts from beyond the arc, a 58.3% conversion rate that suggests his shooting stroke could be coming around. Naturally, a 12-attempt sample is too small to establish that his shooting struggles are over. However, the timing is encouraging for a Spurs team that is already playing some of the best basketball in the league.

Consider the possibilities: Wembanyama can dominate opponents through his size, finishing ability, rebounding and shot-blocking, even when his jump shot is unreliable. If he becomes a consistent perimeter threat, defending him becomes an entirely different challenge.

Opposing centers cannot comfortably retreat toward the basket if Wembanyama is making three-pointers. Meanwhile, defenders who close out aggressively risk allowing him to attack the rim, where his length and mobility make him exceptionally difficult to contain. Those numbers would be remarkable for virtually any player, but Wembanyama managed to produce them despite struggling badly with his shooting from the perimeter.

Following his 52-point explosion against Dallas, Wembanyama was shooting just 7-for-29 (24%) from mid-range and 12-for-50 (24%) from beyond the three-point line.

Of his 52 points against the Mavericks, 45 came either inside the restricted area or at the free-throw line. He converted 13 of 16 attempts in the restricted area and made 19 of his 23 free throws.
